proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for kasm, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the kasm service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the kasm
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  kasm:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.kasm.loadbalancer.server.port=8443
      - traefik.http.services.kasm.loadbalancer.server.scheme=https
      # The app serves a self-signed certificate: define a serversTransport with insecureSkipVerify: true
      # in Traefik's file provider (named insecure here) and reference it.
      - traefik.http.services.kasm.loadbalancer.serverstransport=insecure@file
      - traefik.http.routers.kasm.rule=Host(`kasm.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.kasm.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.kasm.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.kasm.service=kasm
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.kasm.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.kasm.middlewares=authentik@docker

kubernetes:
# Kasm: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-kasm/blob/master/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
# Security notes:
#   - privileged: the image asks for --privileged; securityContext.privileged is set below.
#   - security_opt apparmor=rootlesskit: Some hosts require this on top of privileged for namespacing to work properly inside the DinD layer. (map to a seccompProfile or AppArmor annotation).
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: kasm-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: kasm
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  KASM_PORT: '443'
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: kasm-opt
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: kasm
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: kasm
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: kasm
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: kasm
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: kasm
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: kasm
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/kasm:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: kasm-env
        ports:
        - name: port-3000
          containerPort: 3000
          protocol: TCP
        - name: port-443
          containerPort: 443
          protocol: TCP
        volumeMounts:
        - name: kasm-opt
          mountPath: /opt
        securityContext:
          privileged: true
      volumes:
      - name: kasm-opt
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: kasm-opt
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: kasm
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: kasm
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: kasm
  ports:
  - name: port-3000
    port: 3000
    targetPort: 3000
    protocol: TCP
  - name: port-443
    port: 443
    targetPort: 443
    protocol: TCP
quadlet:
# kasm.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-kasm/blob/master/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Kasm (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/kasm:latest
ContainerName=kasm
AutoUpdate=registry
PodmanArgs=--privileged
# PodmanArgs=--security-opt apparmor=rootlesskit
Environment=KASM_PORT=443
# Environment=DOCKER_HUB_USERNAME=USER
# Environment=DOCKER_HUB_PASSWORD=PASS
# Environment=DOCKER_MTU=1500
Volume=/path/to/kasm/data:/opt:Z
# Volume=/path/to/kasm/profiles:/profiles:Z
# Volume=/dev/input:/dev/input:Z
# Volume=/run/udev/data:/run/udev/data:Z
PublishPort=3000:3000
PublishPort=443:443
# PodmanArgs=--stop-timeout=90s

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
